description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Hulking Metamorph.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hulking Metamorph
uses.cardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet
